dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: It's the same as in transport... Safety first!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything unsafe around here?

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Dornman Port is safe, of course. I'm just worrying about my daughter, Irmgard.

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: I'm embarrassed to admit it, but I can't believe my daughter — the heir of the Dornmannshaven family — has recently been swept off her feet by a smooth-talking brat...

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: Look, don't take me for some rigid traditionalist. As a cadet branch of the Gunnhildr family, our family is built upon the motto of "Sail Toward Freedom." I fully support the idea of young people following their hearts...

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: That said... the boy is a sailor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong with being a sailor?

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: Well, nothing... It's just that over the past few years, there's been a young sailor who's been drifting from Yilong Wharf to Port Belovodye, toying with girls' hearts in every single port of call.

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: I can't recall the scoundrel's name. But think about it! Could an ordinary sailor possibly have stolen my daughter's heart so?

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: For the sake of Irmgard's happiness, I have to keep a close eye on the company she keeps...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Lindemann
dialogues.text: Nearby? Well... Things have been pretty peaceful lately. The merchant ships that set sail for Liyue and Fontaine have all returned safely. Safety first... Safety first...
